segments.source: _Learning FPGA, yosys, nextpnr, and RISC-V_
segments.translation: *FPGA, yosys, nextpnr, RISC-V 배우기*

segments.source: Mission statement: create teaching material for FPGAs, processor design and RISC-V, using around $40 per students.
segments.translation: 미션 선언문: 학생 1인당 약 40달러를 사용하여 FPGA, 프로세서 설계, RISC-V를 위한 교육 자료를 만듭니다.

segments.source: ![](FemtoRV/TUTORIALS/Images/IceStick_hello.gif)
segments.translation: ![](FemtoRV/TUTORIALS/Images/IceStick_hello.gif)

segments.source: FemtoRV: a minimalistic RISC-V CPU
segments.translation: FemtoRV: 최소주의 RISC-V CPU

segments.source: [FemtoRV](FemtoRV/README.md) is a minimalistic RISC-V design, with easy-to-read Verilog sources directly written from the RISC-V specification.
segments.translation: [FemtoRV](FemtoRV/README.md)는 RISC-V 명세로부터 직접 작성된, 읽기 쉬운 Verilog 소스를 가진 최소주의 RISC-V 설계입니다.

segments.source: The most elementary version (quark), an RV32I core, weights 400 lines of VERILOG (documented version), and 100 lines if you remove the comments.
segments.translation: 가장 기본적인 버전(quark)인 RV32I 코어는 400줄의 VERILOG(주석이 달린 버전)로 이루어져 있으며, 주석을 제거하면 100줄입니다.

segments.source: There are also more elaborate versions, the biggest one (petitbateau) is an RV32IMFC core.
segments.translation: 더 정교한 버전들도 있으며, 그중 가장 큰 것(petitbateau)은 RV32IMFC 코어입니다.

segments.source: The repository also includes a companion SoC, with drivers for an UART, a led matrix, a small OLED display, SPI RAM and SDCard.
segments.translation: 저장소에는 UART, LED 매트릭스, 소형 OLED 디스플레이, SPI RAM, SDCard용 드라이버를 갖춘 동반 SoC도 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.source: Its most basic configuration fits on the Lattice IceStick (< 1280 LUTs).
segments.translation: 가장 기본적인 구성은 Lattice IceStick(< 1280 LUT)에 들어갑니다.

segments.source: It can be used for teaching processor design and RISC-V programming.
segments.translation: 이는 프로세서 설계와 RISC-V 프로그래밍을 가르치는 데 사용될 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Playing with LiteX: plug-and-play system to assemble SOCs
segments.translation: LiteX로 놀아보기: SoC를 조립하는 플러그 앤 플레이 시스템

segments.source: The repository includes [LiteX examples](LiteX/README.md).
segments.translation: 저장소에는 [LiteX 예제](LiteX/README.md)가 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.source: The [LiteX](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex) framework is a well designed and an easy-to-use framework to create SoCs.
segments.translation: [LiteX](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex) 프레임워크는 SoC를 만들기 위한 잘 설계되고 사용하기 쉬운 프레임워크입니다.

segments.source: It lets you create a SoC by assembling components (processor, SDRAM controller, SDCard controller, USB, ...) in Python.
segments.translation: 이를 통해 Python으로 컴포넌트(프로세서, SDRAM 컨트롤러, SDCard 컨트롤러, USB 등)를 조립하여 SoC를 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.source: FemtoRV is directly supported by LiteX (that directly downloads it from this repository when selected as the SoC's processor).
segments.translation: FemtoRV는 LiteX에 의해 직접 지원됩니다(SoC의 프로세서로 선택되면 이 저장소로부터 직접 다운로드됩니다).

segments.source: From Blinky to RISC-V
segments.translation: Blinky에서 RISC-V까지

segments.source: In [Episode I](https://github.com/BrunoLevy/learn-fpga/blob/master/FemtoRV/TUTORIALS/FROM_BLINKER_TO_RISCV/README.md), you will learn to build your own RISC-V processor, step by step, starting from the simplest design (that blinks a LED), to a fully functional RISC-V core that can compute and display graphics.
segments.translation: [1화](https://github.com/BrunoLevy/learn-fpga/blob/master/FemtoRV/TUTORIALS/FROM_BLINKER_TO_RISCV/README.md)에서는, LED를 깜빡이는 가장 단순한 설계에서 시작하여, 계산을 수행하고 그래픽을 표시할 수 있는 완전한 기능의 RISC-V 코어에 이르기까지, 단계별로 자신만의 RISC-V 프로세서를 만드는 방법을 배웁니다.

segments.source: In [Episode II](https://github.com/BrunoLevy/learn-fpga/blob/master/FemtoRV/TUTORIALS/FROM_BLINKER_TO_RISCV/PIPELINE.md), you will learn how to design a pipelined processor.
segments.translation: [2화](https://github.com/BrunoLevy/learn-fpga/blob/master/FemtoRV/TUTORIALS/FROM_BLINKER_TO_RISCV/PIPELINE.md)에서는, 파이프라인 프로세서를 설계하는 방법을 배웁니다.

segments.source: Links - Other FPGA resources
segments.translation: 링크 - 기타 FPGA 자료

segments.source: [TinyPrograms](https://github.com/BrunoLevy/TinyPrograms) Tiny yet interesting C programs to play with your softcore
segments.translation: [TinyPrograms](https://github.com/BrunoLevy/TinyPrograms) 소프트코어를 가지고 놀 수 있는 작지만 흥미로운 C 프로그램들

segments.source: [LiteX](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex) Framework in Amaranth (Python-based HDL) to build SOCs
segments.translation: [LiteX](https://github.com/enjoy-digital/litex) SoC를 만들기 위한 Amaranth(Python 기반 HDL) 프레임워크

segments.source: [Silice](https://github.com/sylefeb/Silice) A new HDL by my friend Sylvain Lefebvre
segments.translation: [Silice](https://github.com/sylefeb/Silice) 제 친구 Sylvain Lefebvre가 만든 새로운 HDL

segments.translation: [FuseSOC](https://github.com/olofk/fusesoc)와 [Edalize](https://github.com/olofk/edalize), FPGA 도구의 패키지 관리자 및 추상화 계층

segments.source: [PipelineC](https://github.com/JulianKemmerer/PipelineC) Transform a C program into a pipelined specialized core !
segments.translation: [PipelineC](https://github.com/JulianKemmerer/PipelineC) C 프로그램을 파이프라인화된 특수 코어로 변환합니다!

segments.source: [ultraembedded](https://github.com/ultraembedded/) Amazing resources, [FatIOLib](https://github.com/ultraembedded/fat_io_lib),[ExactStep](https://github.com/ultraembedded/exactstep)...
segments.translation: [ultraembedded](https://github.com/ultraembedded/) 놀라운 자료들, [FatIOLib](https://github.com/ultraembedded/fat_io_lib), [ExactStep](https://github.com/ultraembedded/exactstep) 등

segments.source: [picoRV](https://github.com/YosysHQ/picorv32) by Claire Wolf, my principal source of inspiration
segments.translation: [picoRV](https://github.com/YosysHQ/picorv32) Claire Wolf 작품, 제 주된 영감의 원천입니다

segments.source: [VexRiscV](https://github.com/SpinalHDL/VexRiscv) and [NaxRiscV](https://github.com/SpinalHDL/NaxRiscv), performant and configurable pipelined and OoO cores, by Charles Papon, in SpinalHDL
segments.translation: [VexRiscV](https://github.com/SpinalHDL/VexRiscv)와 [NaxRiscV](https://github.com/SpinalHDL/NaxRiscv), SpinalHDL로 작성된, Charles Papon이 만든 성능 좋고 구성 가능한 파이프라인 및 비순차(OoO) 코어들

segments.source: [SERV](https://github.com/olofk/serv) the tiniest RiscV core, with a bit-serial ALU
segments.translation: [SERV](https://github.com/olofk/serv) 비트 시리얼 ALU를 가진, 가장 작은 RiscV 코어

segments.source: [DarkRiscV](https://github.com/darklife/darkriscv) a simple pipelined core (written in one night according to the legend)
segments.translation: [DarkRiscV](https://github.com/darklife/darkriscv) 전설에 따르면 하룻밤 만에 작성된 단순한 파이프라인 코어

segments.source: [kianRiscV](https://github.com/splinedrive/kianRiscV) a simple yet complete Linux-capable core + soc
segments.translation: [kianRiscV](https://github.com/splinedrive/kianRiscV) 단순하지만 완전한 Linux 구동 가능 코어 + SoC

segments.source: [TinySys](https://github.com/ecilasun/tinysys/wiki) not that tiny SOC and OS
segments.translation: [TinySys](https://github.com/ecilasun/tinysys/wiki) 그리 작지 않은 SoC 및 OS

segments.source: [Will Green's project F](https://github.com/projf/projf-explore) tutorials with nice graphics effects
segments.translation: [Will Green의 프로젝트 F](https://github.com/projf/projf-explore) 튜토리얼, 멋진 그래픽 효과를 담고 있습니다

segments.source: [fpga4fun](https://www.fpga4fun.com/) learned there how to create VGA graphics
segments.translation: [fpga4fun](https://www.fpga4fun.com/)에서 VGA 그래픽을 만드는 방법을 배웠습니다

segments.source: [CoreScore](https://corescore.store/) how many cores can you fit on a FPGA ?
segments.translation: [CoreScore](https://corescore.store/) FPGA에 코어를 몇 개나 담을 수 있는지 확인해 봅시다

segments.source: Basic: more basic things I wrote during May 2020 - June 2020
segments.translation: Basic: 2020년 5월-6월에 작성한 더 기초적인 것들입니다

segments.source: Files are [here](https://github.com/BrunoLevy/learn-fpga/tree/master/Basic).
segments.translation: 파일은 [여기](https://github.com/BrunoLevy/learn-fpga/tree/master/Basic)에 있습니다.

segments.source: This includes:
segments.translation: 여기에는 다음이 포함됩니다:

segments.source: Blinker: the "hello world" program
segments.translation: Blinker: "hello world" 프로그램입니다

segments.source: LedMatrix: play with a 8x8 let matrix, driven by a MAX7219 IC.
segments.translation: LedMatrix: MAX7219 IC로 구동되는 8x8 LED 매트릭스를 다뤄봅니다

segments.source: OLed: play with a SSD1351 OLed display, driven by a 4-wire SPI protocol.
segments.translation: OLed: 4선 SPI 프로토콜로 구동되는 SSD1351 OLed 디스플레이를 다뤄봅니다

segments.source: Serial: access the included USB-virtual UART pins
segments.translation: Serial: 포함된 USB 가상 UART 핀에 접근합니다

segments.source: LedTerminal: display scrolling messages on the LED matrix, obtained from the USB virtual UART
segments.translation: LedTerminal: USB 가상 UART에서 받은 메시지를 LED 매트릭스에 스크롤 표시합니다

segments.source: FOMU: simple examples for the "FPGA in a USB dongle", including the FrankenVGA experiment !
segments.translation: FOMU: "USB 동글 안의 FPGA"를 위한 간단한 예제들이며, FrankenVGA 실험도 포함합니다!

segments.source: ULX3S HDMI: simple self-contained heavily commented HDMI example.
segments.translation: ULX3S HDMI: 간단하고 독립적이며 주석이 상세한 HDMI 예제입니다
